verses.en: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.pt: E, passando Jesus, viu um homem que era cego de nascimento.

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.pt: E os seus discípulos perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Rabi, quem pecou, este ou seus pais, para que nascesse cego?

verses.en: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.pt: Jesus respondeu: Nem este pecou, nem seus pais; mas foi para que se manifestem nele as obras de Deus.

verses.en: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.pt: Eu tenho de fazer as obras daquele que me enviou, enquanto é dia; a noite vem, quando ninguém pode trabalhar.

verses.en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.pt: Enquanto estou no mundo, sou a luz do mundo.

verses.en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.pt: Dito isto, cuspiu na terra, e fez lodo com a saliva, e untou com o lodo os olhos do cego,

verses.en: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe: Vai, lava-te no tanque de Siloé (que significa: Enviado). E ele foi, lavou-se, e veio vendo.

verses.en: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.pt: Então os vizinhos, e aqueles que dantes viam que era cego, diziam: Porventura não é este aquele que estava assentado e mendigava?

verses.en: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.pt: Uns diziam: É ele. Outros: Parece-se com ele. Mas ele dizia: Sou eu.

verses.en: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.pt: Diziam-lhe, pois: Como se te abriram os olhos?

verses.en: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Um homem chamado Jesus fez lodo, untou-me os olhos, e disse-me: Vai ao tanque de Siloé, e lava-te. E eu fui, lavei-me, e vi.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe: Onde está ele? Ele disse: Não sei.

verses.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.pt: Levaram aos fariseus aquele que dantes era cego.

verses.en: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.pt: Ora, era sábado o dia em que Jesus tinha feito o lodo, e lhe abriu os olhos.

verses.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe, pois, os fariseus outra vez como tinha recebido a vista. E ele lhes disse: Pôs-me lodo nos olhos, e me lavei, e vejo.

verses.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.pt: Então alguns dos fariseus diziam: Este homem não é de Deus, porque não guarda o sábado. Outros diziam: Como pode um homem pecador fazer tais sinais? E havia divisão entre eles.

verses.en: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, in that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.pt: Tornaram a dizer ao cego: Tu que dizes dele, visto que te abriu os olhos? E ele disse: É um profeta.

verses.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.pt: Mas os judeus não criam que ele tinha sido cego, e que tinha recebido a vista, até que chamaram os pais daquele que tinha recebido a vista.

verses.en: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.pt: E perguntaram-lhes, dizendo: É este vosso filho, que vós dizeis que nasceu cego? Como, pois, agora vê?

verses.en: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.pt: Os pais responderam e disseram: Sabemos que este é nosso filho, e que nasceu cego;

verses.en: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.pt: Mas como agora vê, não sabemos; ou quem lhe abriu os olhos, nós não sabemos. Ele é maior de idade; perguntai-lhe a si mesmo, ele falará de si mesmo.

verses.en: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.pt: Os pais disseram isto porque temiam os judeus; pois os judeus já tinham concordado em que, se alguém confessasse que era Cristo, seria expulso da sinagoga.

verses.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.pt: Por isto é que seus pais disseram: Ele é maior de idade; perguntai-lhe a si mesmo.

verses.en: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.pt: Chamaram, pois, pela segunda vez o homem que tinha sido cego, e lhe disseram: Dá glória a Deus; nós sabemos que esse homem é pecador.

verses.en: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: Se ele é pecador, não sei; uma coisa sei, que, sendo eu cego, agora vejo.

verses.en: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.pt: Tornaram-lhe a dizer: Que te fez? Como te abriu os olhos?

verses.en: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes: Já volo disse, e não ouvistes; por que quereis ouvir outra vez? Porventura vós também quereis tornar-vos seus discípulos?

verses.en: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.pt: E o injuriaram, e disseram: Tu és discípulo dele; mas nós somos discípulos de Moisés.

verses.en: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.pt: Nós sabemos que Deus falou a Moisés; mas, quanto a este, não sabemos donde é.

verses.en: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes aquele homem: Pois nisto é admirável, que vós não saibais donde ele é, e contudo ele me abriu os olhos.

verses.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.pt: Sabemos que Deus não ouve pecadores; mas se alguém é temente a Deus, e faz a sua vontade, a esse ouve.

verses.en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.pt: Desde o princípio do mundo nunca se ouviu dizer que alguém abrisse os olhos de um cego de nascença.

verses.en: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.pt: Se este não fosse de Deus, não poderia fazer nada.

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe: Tu nasceste todo em pecado, e nos ensinas? E o expulsaram fora.

verses.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.pt: Ouviu Jesus que o tinham expulsado e, encontrando-o, disse-lhe: Crês tu no Filho de Deus?

verses.en: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.pt: Respondeu ele, e disse: Senhor, quem é ele, para que eu creia nele?

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Tu já o tens visto, e aquele que fala contigo, esse é ele.

verses.en: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.pt: E ele disse: Creio, Senhor! E o adorou.

verses.en: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.pt: E disse Jesus: Eu vim para juízo a este mundo; para que os que não veem vejam, e os que veem sejam cegos.

verses.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we then blind?
verses.pt: E alguns dos fariseus que estavam com ele, ouvindo isto, perguntaram-lhe: Porventura nós também somos cegos?

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Se fôsseis cegos, não teríeis pecado; mas como dizeis: Vemos, o vosso pecado permanece.
